summary: Tested Mode Terrain (Field Mode) for CC2026 - All backend APIs and frontend UI working correctly. 13/13 backend tests passed (green/orange/red badge validation, affluence counter, search, manual check-in, reset presence). Frontend shows Scanner QR button, real-time Affluence widget, quick search with 'Pointer' button, and Derniers scans section. Design follows #F4F1EA background with dark typography.

issues: Camera access fails in automated testing environment (expected) - shows proper error message 'Impossible d'accéder à la caméra. Vérifiez les permissions.'

critical_code_review_comments: All terrain APIs correctly implemented with proper color coding (green/orange/red)
Battery optimization feature mentioned in UI - scanner stops automatically when closed
html5-qrcode library used for QR scanning
Affluence widget auto-refreshes every 10 seconds (fetchAffluence interval)
Debounced search (300ms) prevents excessive API calls
Real-time updates working correctly - counter updates immediately after check-in
